title: 2hrs- Beyond the Bridge - Marin Headlands GoCar Tour
includes: 8.75% environmental fee for carbon offset, gas and tire recycling
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the Ultimate San Francisco Adventure in a GoCAR EV Sport!

Embark on a one-of-a-kind San Francisco tour as you drive north across the iconic Golden Gate Bridge in our all-new GoCAR EV Sport, a freeway-legal, electric Arcimoto FUV (Fun Utility Vehicle). This three-wheeled motorcycle offers an exciting, open-air driving experience for two, with a top speed of 75 mph and tandem seating designed for maximum fun and visibility.

Explore the breathtaking Marin Headlands, a stunning natural park just minutes from the city, featuring panoramic views, wildlife, and unforgettable photo opportunities. On your return, cruise down the world-famous Crooked Lombard Street—a must-see San Francisco landmark.

This eco-friendly, electric vehicle tour offers unbeatable views, lasting memories, and a unique way to explore beyond the city. Perfect for adventure seekers and sightseers looking to experience the best of San Francisco’s scenic drives.
